<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="תמוז_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518919223_theRebbe_96" batchId="meluket-_D7_AA_D7_9E_D7_95_D7_96_meluket__BH_POST_1766518919223_theRebbe_96__p007">
  <section v="18">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>Poverty is negated only by a wealth beyond filling lack, not by mere sufficiency, and lower daat leaves a hidden lack in the person because his consciousness of G-d is an addition to his own existence.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And according to what was explained above in section 4, that the negation of poverty</t>
    <t s="1">(lack)</t>
    <t s="2">is specifically through the wealth that is above filling the lack,</t>
    <t s="3">but not when the flow is only enough for his lack</t>
    <t s="4">[including also the matter of "that which he lacks"—</t>
    <t s="5">,</t>
    <t s="6">even a horse to ride upon and a servant to run before him]</t>
    <t s="7">there remains</t>
    <t s="8">(in inwardness)</t>
    <t s="9">a lack also regarding the contracted flow,</t>
    <t s="10">it must be said,</t>
    <t s="11">that even when the service is from the aspect of daat,</t>
    <t s="12">recognition and feeling,</t>
    <t s="13">but only lower daat that receives from Arich,</t>
    <t s="14">the service is like something additional upon him,</t>
    <t s="15">and the person himself</t>
    <t s="16">(in his inwardness)</t>
    <t s="17">lacks the service,</t>
    <t s="18">meaning that there remains a place in the person where the revelation of G-dliness does not shine.</t>
    <t s="19">For although the matter of recognition and feeling</t>
    <t s="20">(even of lower daat)</t>
    <t s="21">is that the person himself recognizes and feels</t>
    <t s="22">(as above in section 3),</t>
    <t s="23">nevertheless,</t>
    <t s="24">since the essence of the person is existence</t>
    <t s="25">(and not that his essence is the feeling of G-dliness),</t>
    <t s="26">his recognition and feeling of G-dliness is like something additional upon him.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="19">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>Lower daat itself grants place to existence outside G-d, whereas upper daat from Atik, the Essence of Ein Sof, reveals that G-d's true existence is the true existence of all beings, filling all lack.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And on a deeper level it may be said,</t>
    <t s="1">that this—that in the service of lower daat a lack still remains—</t>
    <t s="2">is not only because the person and his recognition of G-dliness are two things,</t>
    <t s="3">but also from the aspect of the recognition itself</t>
    <t s="4">(the recognition of lower daat)</t>
    <t s="5">there is a granting of place to an existence outside of G-dliness.</t>
    <t s="6">For since lower daat receives from the externality of Keter,</t>
    <t s="7">Arich,</t>
    <t s="8">which in general is the aspect of Sovev that is like a source for worlds,</t>
    <t s="9">therefore,</t>
    <t s="10">even from the aspect of daat itself there is a granting of place to existence.</t>
    <t s="11">And this itself is the reason that through the revelation of this level in the person, he remains in his existence,</t>
    <t s="12">an existence outside of G-dliness.</t>
    <t s="13">And in order for the lack to be completely filled,</t>
    <t s="14">that is, that there be no place where the revelation of G-dliness does not shine,</t>
    <t s="15">it is through the service of upper daat that receives from the inwardness of Keter,</t>
    <t s="16">Atik,</t>
    <t s="17">which in general is the Essence of Ein Sof.</t>
    <t s="18">For regarding the Essence of Ein Sof, there is no existence outside of Him,</t>
    <t s="19">and on the contrary,</t>
    <t s="20">His true existence is the true existence of all beings.</t>
    <t s="21">Therefore, through the revelation of upper daat,</t>
    <t s="22">the person's recognition of G-dliness is in a manner that this</t>
    <t s="23">(the recognition of G-dliness)</t>
    <t s="24">is his entire existence.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="20">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>Moshe's prayer to fill Knesset Yisrael's lack is called a rich man's prayer because from the perspective of upper daat, even their lack is not a lack, and his prayer was that this truth be revealed to them.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And based on this, we may explain why Moshe's prayer to fill the lack of Knesset Yisrael is called a rich man's prayer,</t>
    <t s="1">even though the lack of Knesset Yisrael certainly affected him greatly,</t>
    <t s="2">for Moshe is the aspect of upper daat</t>
    <t s="3">(as above),</t>
    <t s="4">and from the perspective of upper daat,</t>
    <t s="5">the matter of wealth,</t>
    <t s="6">the matter of lack does not apply.</t>
    <t s="7">That is,</t>
    <t s="8">in addition to the fact that in Moshe himself no lack applies, G-d forbid,</t>
    <t s="9">rather, regarding Moshe,</t>
    <t s="10">even the lack of Knesset Yisrael for whom he prayed is not a lack,</t>
    <t s="11">for upper daat receives from Atik,</t>
    <t s="12">and therefore it is felt in him that His true existence is the true existence of all beings and they lack nothing.</t>
    <t s="13">And although Moshe prayed for them,</t>
    <t s="14">and the matter of prayer is to fill the lack—it may be said,</t>
    <t s="15">that his prayer was that this matter</t>
    <t s="16">(that the truth is that they lack nothing)</t>
    <t s="17">be felt in revelation also by them.</t>
    <t s="18">But in Moshe this was felt</t>
    <t s="19">(that they lack nothing)</t>
    <t s="20">in revelation even when they were in a state that required him to pray for them,</t>
    <t s="21">and therefore,</t>
    <t s="22">his prayer is a rich man's prayer.</t>
    <t s="23">And to add,</t>
    <t s="24">that this—that Moshe's prayer is called a rich man's prayer—is not only because even then</t>
    <t s="25">(at the time of prayer)</t>
    <t s="26">he was rich,</t>
    <t s="27">but moreover,</t>
    <t s="28">his prayer was because he is rich.</t>
    <t s="29">For Moshe's prayer that the lack of Knesset Yisrael be filled</t>
    <t s="30">[Knesset Yisrael simply,</t>
    <t s="31">and through this—the lack of Malchus,</t>
    <t s="32">and of the world]</t>
    <t s="33">is that the lack be completely filled,</t>
    <t s="34">that there be no place where the revelation of G-dliness does not shine,</t>
    <t s="35">and in order for the lack to be completely filled, it is specifically through the revelation of upper daat,</t>
    <t s="36">as above.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
